prompts:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: logo concept for Partydeck, a premium web-based social poker and blackjack app where friends share a table screen and play with their phones.
Primary request: One refined, minimal, modern black-and-white logo. A distinctive compact symbol of two overlapping playing cards, with a simple spade integrated through negative space, paired with the wordmark "partydeck" in lowercase. The mark should read immediately as playing cards and be recognizable at small app-icon size. Restrained and friendly, with slightly rounded geometry and precise optical spacing.
Scene/backdrop: flat clean white background.
Composition: one centered horizontal logo lockup, generous whitespace, symbol left and wordmark right, large enough to inspect. A single design, not a brand board.
Style: crisp flat vector-like graphic, strong solid black shapes, contemporary carefully kerned sans-serif lettering, no intricate outlines.
Text verbatim: "partydeck"
Avoid: gradients, shadows, 3D, mockups, textures, confetti, party hats, chips, crowns, slogans, extra text, watermarks, multiple variations.

Use case: background-extraction
Edit this Partydeck logo presentation only: place the existing black logo and black wordmark on a fully opaque pure WHITE background (#ffffff). No transparency anywhere in this output. The background must visibly be white, with strong black-on-white contrast. Keep the existing two-card symbol, its white spade, the exact lowercase "partydeck" wordmark, proportions, typography and layout unchanged. Flat graphic, no shadows or glow.
